findings.summary: `assert doc["finding_count"] >= 1` is nearly tautological (true even at 3+ findings) and does no real work — the test's actual dedup verification rides entirely on the two assertions that follow. A bug that dedups the repeated id correctly but accidentally duplicates the distinct one (e.g. `ids == ["...D9", "...D1", "...D1"]`) would still pass this line and the `in ids` check below it. Tightening to `== 2` would catch that class of regression.
